name: Form Effluent Plant (Web)
implementation_notes: The Effluent Plant Detail grid is fully dynamic -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() on FormEffluentPlant.php, exactly mirroring FormProcessWater's grid. Grid starts empty on create mode; edit mode loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 19 non-time_slot columns per row are genuinely editable, never disabled -- Effluent Plant has no computed detail-grid fields. 3 of them (Biogas Flare Status, Dosing Pump 1 Status, Sludge Dewatering Status) render as <select> dropdowns with an empty '-- Pilih --' option

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: the 3 enum dropdowns submit '' when left unselected; EffluentPlantRecordService::normalizeDetails() (shared with screen-095) coerces this to null before validation/persistence, avoiding a SQLite CHECK constraint violation -- verified by a dedicated unit test and a Feature/Api test (Kernel Dispatch previously hit this same failure mode; fixed here proactively before it could recur)
UNLIKE Form Threshing Web: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind
Route /data/effluent-plant/create registered BEFORE /data/effluent-plant/{id} (screen-105) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormProcessWater's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By)
NoActiveEffluentPlantStationException (mirrors NoActiveProcessWaterStationException) thrown when production_line_id has no active station type=effluent-plant
